notes.title: Development Update & New Timeline
notes.content:
[p]✨ [b]Little Update[/b][/p][p]
I recently started a new job, which is why I’ve been a bit quiet.[/p][p]This means the release of [b]Super Tennis Breakout[/b] will be slightly delayed. I used to work on it full-time, but now I’ll continue part-time. Right now, I’m aiming for a [b]December release[/b] if everything goes well.[/p][p][/p][p]🎾 The demo is currently offline, but I’ll be updating it soon with fresh improvements and then re-releasing it![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all so much for your support and patience ❤️[/p]
